summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, furnishing a press release dated October 14, 2026, that solely announces the scheduling of its third quarter 2026 financial and operational results. Results will be released after North American markets close on November 4, 2026, followed by a conference call on November 5, 2026, at 9:00 am PT / 11:00 am ET, with a two-week replay. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; this is a routine earnings-notice filing, not a special situation.
